{{Quote|I am al'Lan Mandragoran... Lord of the Seven Towers, Defender of the Wall of First Fires, Bearer of the Sword of the Thousand Lakes!... I may be a king without a land. '''But I am still King!'''|[[Lan Mandragoran]]}}
{{dablink|For other uses of the word "tower," see [[Tower]].}}
'''Lord of the Seven Towers''' is a title [[Lan Mandragoran]] claimed for himself just prior to ordering his army of twelve thousand to charge one hundred fifty thousand [[Shadowspawn]] at [[Tarwin's Gap]].

As [[Malkier]] was called the Kingdom of the Seven Towers,{{ref|{{bwb}} The Borderlands}} due to the [[Seven Towers]] on its city's walls, Lan was undoubtedly referring to them when he made his proclamation.
